articleTitle: Eyeing3D: perceiving 3D from 2D images
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The recent vision foundation models, e.g. Segment Anything Model (SAM), have shown great potential in various downstream 2D tasks. However, their adaptability to 3D vision remains an unexplored area. In this paper, we propose a novel generative framework, namely Eyeing3D, by integrating generative vision models of multiple purposes (including SAM and Neural Radiance Fields) to achieve human's uncanny capability to perceive and interpret the 3D structure of a visual object, even when it is represented in a single 2D image. Particularly, a user is granted the ability to select any visual object of interest in the input 2D image with a simple click or bounding box, facilitating the reconstruction of its 3D model, with the added ability to manipulate the visual style and viewing angle. In the experiments, the effectiveness of our proposed Eyeing3D is demonstrated, showcasing improved performance in image-based 3D reconstruction tasks.

articleTitle: Identity authentication techniques for unmanned ships communication based on MITRE ATT&CK framework
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: With the development of the smart ship industry, unmanned ship technology is rapidly evolving. In this paper, our objective is to analyze potential risks associated with identity authentication technology in unmanned ship communication systems. To effectively address these risks, we propose the utilization of the MITRE ATT&CK framework to organize and implement defense strategies. This framework offers a comprehensive and systematic approach to understanding potential threats and designing appropriate defensive measures. To validate the effectiveness of our proposed defense framework, we have also conducted simulation experiments. These experiments assist us in evaluating the efficiency and reliability of the strategies in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Grape farm pest bird sound detection system using embedded systems
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Crops are essential for fuelling economies, and agricultural fields require proper care to ensure food production. This project focuses on addressing the presence of pest birds, specifically mynah birds, in vineyards. The proposed approach utilizes sound signals to detect and identify the mynah birds in the vineyard. By analysing the surrounding environment's audio inputs, the system can accurately identify distinct sound patterns of mynah birds, using Deep Learning. Additionally, the project incorporates distance estimation techniques using ultrasonic sensors to calculate the bird's proximity from a fixed position within the vineyard. All the detection and estimation processes are performed on the RP2040 microcontroller, specifically the Cortex-M0+ 133MHz variant. After detection has been done, a robotic vehicle outfitted with red diode lasers can be dispatched to the desired location to chase the pest birds away while protecting the vineyards from undesired exposures and crop losses.

articleTitle: Optical dual sensor for the simultaneous detection of oxygen and nitric oxide based on electrospun fibers double-layer
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative approach to achieving optical dual sensors capable of detecting oxygen and nitric oxide simultaneously. The key components employed in this system encompass platinum (II) meso-tetrakis (pentafluorophenyl) porphyrin (PtTFPP) and CsPbBr3 perovskite quantum dots incorporated within a cellulose acetate (CA) polymer matrix, the fabrication process centers around electrospinning. This method yields the desired double-layer electrospun fibers. The optical excitation for the fibers is facilitated by a 380 nm LED light source. The empirical outcomes of the optical dual sensor experimentation show that oxygen and nitric oxide fluorescence sensitivity are 7.6 and 4.2, respectively. Finally, The proposed optical dual sensor can simultaneously detect oxygen and nitric oxygen for practical applications.

articleTitle: Contactless palm-vein recognition for e-commerce
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This study proposed a palm vein recognition system for credit card transactions. When the transaction amount exceeds the predefined signature exemption limit, palm vein recognition is triggered for user recognition. The system utilizes CNN to verify the user's palm vein image, achieving highly accurate identity authentication, which provides an Equal Error Rate (EER) of 0.239%. This system also has the potential to be applied on edge devices and achieve efficient and fast identity verification.

articleTitle: An application of cost, resilience and leadership for implementation of PV, solar thermal and ASHP
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The objective of this research was to investigate and evaluate the cost, resilience and leadership including situational and transformational leadership in the aspects of the implementation of sustainable energy technologies (SETs), e.g., Photovoltaic, Solar Thermal and Air Source Heat Pump. The findings of this research indicated that the cost has a negative but strong and significant relationship with the implementation of SETs. Similarly, the results presented that the implementation of SETs has positively, strongly and significantly impacted the business through energy resilience. Finally, it showed that leadership is positively, strongly and significantly related to the implementation of such technologies. In addition, situational leadership style has non relationship with the implementation of such technologies whereas transformational leadership style has positively, strongly and significantly related to the implementation of SETs.

articleTitle: Enhancing SNN performance by using dynamic membrane threshold and inhibitory block division
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are artificial neural networks inspired by the functioning of biological neurons. Unlike traditional neural networks, SNNs communicate through discrete, time-based signals called spikes, enabling parallel and energy-efficient information processing. While SNNs can capture biological properties that are not feasible with traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), existing learning methods for SNNs suffer from either poor performance or unreliable biological plausibility. In this paper, we propose an improvement approach that enhances performance by increasing the biological plausibility. Specifically, we divide the inhibitory layer into multiple blocks, allowing excitatory neurons to only inhibit neighboring neurons. In the training of SNNs, there is a reduction in spike activity with each layer, leading to suboptimal performance in the final classification. To address this, we incorporate the dynamic threshold method, ensuring complete spike emission in SNNs. We evaluate the performance of our method on the MNIST dataset, demonstrating its superiority in terms of accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods. Our proposed approach provides a promising solution to the problem of incomplete spike emission in SNNs and offers potential for improved performance and efficiency in various SNN applications.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation of adult liver and its accessory structures based on Swin transformer
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Ultrasound (US) standard section images result from systematic scans guided by clinical criteria. Vital anatomical structures within these sections are essential for accurate diagnosis. Specific anatomical features within the US image determine its classification as a standard section. In this paper, we adopt the method of using a Swin Transformer (Swin-T) as the backbone of the UperNet segmentation model to semantically segment the liver and its accessory structures under the standard section of liver US The dataset contains 6428 images from the Second Hospital of Fujian Medical University, covering six anatomical structures across six standard views. Results demonstrate the method's effectiveness, achieving a mDice score of 85.31% and a mAcc of 85.90% for liver and accessory structure segmentation. These outcomes underscore the successful semantic segmentation of the liver and its adjunct structures.

articleTitle: The development of the vertical take-off and landing UAV
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In the history of UAV development, we have seen the progression from the fixed-wing UAV to the multirotor drones, and eventually, the integration of fixed-wing and multirotor capabilities, commonly referred to as VTOL (Vertical Take-Off and Landing) UAV.

articleTitle: A predictive model for turbine energy yield estimation in a combined cycle power plant
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Gas turbines are a key player in the energy generation sector and thus form a key component in energy systems as a critical infrastructure. The determination of key parameters in optimization and efficiency of the gas turbines are of utmost importance to increase their power conversion efficiency. This paper presents a simple power estimation model for a gas turbine considering all its parameters. 7412 multivariate data records from the UCI Machine Learning Repository were used in the development of a linear prediction model for estimating the turbine energy yield for a combined cycle power plant. Simulation results show that the inlet temperature of the turbine is the most critical parameter that predicts its energy yield capacity, while ambient atmospheric conditions of temperature, humidity and pressure do not predict its energy yield capacity.

articleTitle: Effective RTL locking for obfuscation of loop-based designs
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: RTL Locking is a design technique that aims to enhance hardware security by obfuscating the circuit semantics. Various methods for RTL locking have been proposed in prior literature. However, when applied simultaneously to loop-based designs, these methods may not effectively improve security due to semantic conflicts. In this paper, we investigate the feasibility of different combinations of methods in light of this observation. Additionally, we conduct a detailed analysis of the design overhead associated with feasible method combinations. The research findings presented in this paper can serve as guidelines for the design of RTL loop hardware obfuscation.

articleTitle: Life cycle assessment in simplified interior construction
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Facing the Net Zero greenhouse gas emission in 2050 is the important issue in this moment. Carbon emission of whole industry procedure is evaluated by life cycle assessment (LCA). This study focuses on the LCA in interior construction from the raw materials to building materials, transportation, interior installation, usage and maintenance, demolition and recycling. Also considering the carbon footprints evaluation, all related items are included such as materials, transportation, construction in partition, surface of walls, floors, ceilings, and system furniture. The assessment in carbon footprints per square meter of indoor area is setup as carbon equivalent (kgCO2e/m2) during the construction procedure. The database is the standard value by collected and analysed carbon footprint in every part of interior construction. The next step will focus on the parts of usage and maintenance, demolition and recycling.

articleTitle: Enhance the computational edge devices with lightweight attention and transferrable awareness
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Amidst the surge in technological trends in consumer devices like smart things, including interaction content tools, which demand the use of a compact yet powerful computer. a challenge arises in conserving information durability while compressing it. In response, we introduce an innovative approach to address transferable knowledge comprehensively, elevating the capabilities of the lightweight subspace-attentive domain for accelerated perception. Besides, this is viable to consumer edge devices. Demonstrated by benchmarks, our average perception capability rises significantly to 88.4%, with the potential to reduce model and computation complexity by 10-20 times. This underscore enhanced viability and resilience for broader deployment in the future.

articleTitle: Improved bilateral filter using smoother difference and adaptive sum
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The bilateral filter is widely used in signal processing because it can remove the noise while preserving the edges. However, if the filter response decays fast with the value difference, then the noise with higher amplitude cannot be removed. By contrast, if the filter response decays slowly with the value difference, then the edge may not be preserved and the ridge and valley will be over-smoothed. In this work, two techniques are proposed to improve the bilateral filter. First, instead of using the value difference, we assign the filter response according to the difference of the smoother outputs. Second, we set the output as a combination of the bilateral filter output and the input and the weight is set by the difference of the input and its smoother version. With these techniques, the noise can be effectively removed while well preserving the edges, ridges, and valleys.

articleTitle: Strategy for stable in-hand manipulation with humanoid-pinch gripper
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In previous work on manipulation with robotic hands, full actuated fingers were mainly used to replicate a natural human hand. However, fully actuated fingers face challenges in terms of high cost and complex control requirements. As a result, there has been an increasing interest in underactuated anthropomorphic fingers as a research focus. Since it is difficult to acquire precise models for the gripper, object, and contacts, manipulation with underactuated fingers is a challenging issue. This paper proposes strategies to improve the smoothness of the manipulation process and introduces new parameters to explicitly express the relations between object motion and actuator displacements. Through calibrated experiments, results have demonstrated that the proposed manipulation strategies are stable, and the expressions are realistic.

articleTitle: A lightweight framework for staged remaining useful life prediction of rotating machinery based on monotonicity and dynamic adjustment
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Rotating machinery is widely used in various fields, including wind turbines, automobile engines, and industrial equipment. Therefore, accurate prediction of the remaining useful life of the machinery is crucial for developing appropriate maintenance plans and minimizing costs. However, due to the unpredictability of the environment and uncontrollable operating factors, traditional methods lack the ability to dynamically adjust prediction models based on real-time machine or plant conditions, making it difficult to accurately assess RUL. To address these challenges, we propose an RUL prediction method that combines unsupervised learning using K-means and monotonicity-based feature selection techniques, along with the utilization of artificial neural networks for simplified calculations and improved real-time results. Compared to existing research methods, our approach dynamically adjusts relevant features based on machine condition, resulting in significantly reduced errors by 95.59% to 96s.76% and significantly decreased parameter count by 96.92% to 99.36%, thus achieving lower computational costs.

articleTitle: Study on screw filtration system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This research focuses on developing a screw detection system using Yolo series object detection models and the OpenCV module. The plan uses a camera to detect and identify different types of screws on various production lines in real time. The Yolo series object detection models allow training custom objects to see corresponding screws. The performance of three models, yolov5s, yolov7-tiny, and yolov8n, is compared based on precision, recall, mAP, and loss to determine suitability. The study used four types of screws, namely screw_1, screw_2, screw_3, and screw_4, as examples of screw detection. Over 1000 images were collected for each type of screw, resulting in 5208 images used for training. In terms of screw detection, a GUI was developed using Python modules to control the detection system. The system provides visual confirmation of recognized screw patterns and displays errors if incorrect screws are detected. The experimental results indicate that in terms of precision, yolov7-tiny achieves the highest score among the Yolo models, followed by yolov8n and yolov5s. Regarding mAP, both yolov5s and yolov8n demonstrate high scores, while yolov7-tiny's mAP falls between 0.5 and 0.6, relatively lower than the other two models. In terms of loss, yolov7-tiny and yolov5s exhibit lower loss values, indicating better prediction results, while yolov8n has a higher loss, leading to poorer recognition performance. Regarding speed, yolov5s performs at 2.6ms, yolov7-tiny at 0.38ms, and yolov8n at 4.2ms.

articleTitle: A historical review of drone performances
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: With advancements in UAV technology and the gradual reduction in their size, UAVs have gradually been introduced into both outdoor and indoor stage performances since the early 2010s. Current UAV performances can be broadly categorized into smaller-scale indoor stage drone show and large-scale swarm drone show. This paper focuses on researching the development of UAV stage performance, while exploring the various possibilities of UAVs as a medium for technology art performances.

articleTitle: Calculate waist trajectory during golf swing from IMU sensing data
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Golf is a prevalent sport globally, and information and communication technology (ICT) can significantly improve a golfer's skills while reducing the risk of injury. This paper introduces a wearable device to track waist movement during a golf swing precisely. By using IMU sensor data, the device can accurately calculate rotation angles and perform coordinate conversions to rectify any inconsistencies within the data coordinate system. Moreover, a drift compensation technique is employed to correct trajectory deviations resulting from data errors. In order to validate the proposed methodology, a test apparatus incorporating fixed motion was utilized. The wearable device successfully provides a waist rotation trajectory with an error margin of ±5 cm.

articleTitle: Facial expression synthesis based on denoising diffusion probabilistic model
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Facial expression synthesis has been receiving more attention for research and application in computer vision. The state-of-the-art latent diffusion model (LDM) can generate high-quality images from text prompts. However, to edit the facial expression of existing images, the model can over-editing and remove some identity from the original images. In this study, we build a facial expression synthesis pipeline to edit the original image with different expressions: anger, disgust, contempt, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and neutral. Our pipeline includes facial segmentation to extract the necessary area for editing, denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPM) with text embedding to generate and control the output expression, and image combining to combine generated image back to the original image. In this paper, we experiment and analyze the potential of DDPM with our method.

articleTitle: Research on bearing diagnosis with a smart gearbox using monitored vibration data
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper presents a research study focused on the development of a smart gearbox system for diagnosing bearings in industrial applications. The printed circuit board (PCB) incorporates a MEMS accelerometer embedded within the gearbox, enabling the wireless transmission of vibration data to a monitoring computer via Wi-Fi. The user interface is designed using LabVIEW, which provides functions for time-domain, frequency-domain, and root mean square (RMS) analysis. The smart gearbox offers several benefits, including flexible installation space, remote monitoring, plug-and-play functionality, and Internet of Things (IoT) capabilities. The study addresses the common issue of bearing damage in industrial gearbox systems. MATLAB is utilized to generate fault signals, and analysis techniques such as kurtogram and envelope analysis are employed to identify the fault frequencies associated with the bearing. Experimental validation is conducted by intentionally inducing manufactured bearing damage. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in accurately detecting and identifying bearing faults. The integration of the smart gearbox system with advanced signal processing techniques enables realtime monitoring and early detection of potential bearing failures, leading to improved system reliability and reduced maintenance costs. This, in turn, facilitates enhanced maintenance strategies and reduced downtime.

articleTitle: A robust model for the intelligent classification of uterine fibroid ultrasound images
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Uterine fibroid (UF) represents the most frequent tumor in women, posing a significant risk for complications, such as miscarriage. Diagnostic accuracy may be affected by physician inexperience and fatigue. We propose a deep learning model, combining the MobileNetV2 and the deep convolutional generative adversarial networks (DCGAN), to support physicians in identifying UF and assessing its characteristics. Our model leverages the superior data augmentation capabilities of DCGAN to generate high-quality UF ultrasound images, and then partitions preprocessed images into UF and non-uterine-fibroid (NUF) classes. Subsequently, the MobileNetV2 model accurately classifies the images based on the data. We verified the performance using some evaluation metrics and compared the automatic classification effects of other models. The real-time classification speed of the hybrid model attains 40 FPS, an accuracy of 97.45%, and an F1 score of 0.9741.

articleTitle: A second order fully passive noise shaping SAR ADC
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper presents a 14-bit second-order fully passive noise shaping (FPNS) successive approximation register (SAR) analog-to-digital converter (ADC), using capacitors and switches to perform a passive integrator and remove a power-hungry operational amplifier. This work employs two circuit techniques, embedded passive gain and passive signal residue summation, to reduce the transistor size of the comparator and capacitor. The cyclic dynamic element matching (CDEM) technique relieves the CDAC mismatch for better PVT robustness. This ADC achieves SNDR of 84.1 dB with a bandwidth of 65.1kHz at an oversampling ratio of 16. It consumes 458μW at a supply voltage of 1.8V using the 180-nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Improvement of electric power quality using a unified power-quality conditioner integrated with a PV system and a supercapacitor
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper proposes a unified power-quality conditioner (UPQC) integrated with a PV system and a supercapacitor (SC) energystorage system (ESS) to achieve power-quality improvement of nonlinear loads connected to a power source. The perturbation and observation (P&O) method joined with the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) scheme is used for the PV system with a PV array connected with a DC-DC boost converter to offer maximum power to the grid and the SC-ESS. The SC-ESS with an SC and a bidirectional DC-DC converter can operate in either charging mode or compensation mode. The proposed UPQC joined with the combined PV system and the SC-ESS scheme can effectively compensate for severe voltage sag and short-term power outage, which the traditional UPQC cannot offer.

articleTitle: A multi-stage dual mode digital LDO with fast transient response and adaptive frequency
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper proposes A Multi-Stage Dual Mode Digital LDO (DDLDO) with Fast Transient Response and Adaptive Frequency. The DDLDO has two types of control loop. One is asynchronous control loop, it is used to improve the transient response under heavy load. Another is synchronous control loop, it uses multiphase Digital Control Oscillator (DCO) to enhance system operation speed, and it has the function of adjusting the clock frequency in the steady state of the system. The proposed DDLDO is implemented in UMC 180nm 1P6M. With VIN=1.2V and 200mV dropout, the proposed LDO can support maximum output current of 50mA with 99.85% current efficiency and settling time is 0.33μs.

articleTitle: FamiPacking: a diffusion model for guiding 3D bin packing
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: 3D bin packing (3D-BPP) is one of the most important problems in logistics. To optimize the packaging material usage, we proposed a novel interactive system based on diffusion models for 3D-BPP, namely FamiPacking, which takes the input of data regarding bins and items to be packed and outputs the minimum number of required bins with a visualization instruction. To our knowledge, this is the first diffusion-based system for packing planning. The techniques behind our FamiPacking have been practiced to deal with real-world challenges and improve the packing system of Taiwan FamilyMart (Taiwan's best convenience store chain).

articleTitle: A large-scale aerial photo shooting system with no time difference based on drone swarm flight
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In the past, aerial photographs were obtained only by satellite aerial photographs, but the cost was not expensive. Later, aerial photographs were obtained through aerial photography through flight mission and orthographic projection and photo stitching technology to obtain aerial photographs. However, due to aerial photographs the aerial photos of each area in the region are taken at different times, resulting in ghost images in the image data. The ghost images are caused by the time difference in taking aerial photos. Therefore, the ghost images produced after such stitching are in many aerial photos. The field of application is not applicable (such as: transportation observation, vehicle detection and tracking...). Therefore, this research will use the remaining set observation points of the drone swarm technology to synchronously shoot aerial photos of each observation point, and then collect the photos through the cloud and perform orthographic projection and post-stitching processing to produce huge aerial photos without time difference image.

articleTitle: Research on CANOpen communication protocal for electric vehicle on-board chargers
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This research focuses on utilizing the CANOpen communication protocol for operating and programming onboard vehicle chargers. With its benefits of high efficiency, reliability, and flexibility, CANOpen is widely adopted in the automobile industry. First of all, the research focused on analysing the fundamental principles and structure of the CANOpen communication protocol. Secondly, we will delve even further into the application of EV chargers during the setup and activation stage. By utilizing CANOpen communication, the onboard charger establishes a seamless and efficient connection with the electric vehicle's central control unit. This connection facilitates essential functions such as the management of charging initiation and termination, precise adjustment of the charging power output, and the comprehensive monitoring of the entire charging process. The experimental results demonstrate the stability and reliability of the vehicle charger when controlled through the CANOpen communication.

articleTitle: The impact of industry 4.0 technologies on sustainable supply chain management
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The advent of Industry 4.0 has revolutionized the way industries operate, with the integration of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things (IoT), and big data analytics. The idea of a sustainable supply chain, which emphasizes sustainability, environmental responsibility, and resource efficiency has also gained a lot of interest. By utilising Industry 4.0 technologies, companies may streamline their supply chain procedures, cut waste, and improve overall sustainability. Furthermore, improvements in visibility and traceability throughout the supply chain are made possible by the integration of IoT devices, which enables real-time monitoring and data collecting. This enhanced transparency enables organisations to identify inefficiencies, reduce waste, and make data-driven decisions to maximise resource use and minimise environmental impact. This study stands out as one of the few attempts to look at the impact of Industry 4.0 technologies on sustainable supply chain practices and performance. This research is going to use the food manufacturing sector as the case study. The data that has been collected is going to be processed using PLS-SEM method. SmartPLS software will be used to test the hypotheses.

articleTitle: 1-D band structure prediction in photonic fishbone structure using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: We aim to train an artificial neural network to predict the band structure of 1-D fishbone photonic nanobeam and find the slow light mode in the structure. Using the geometric parameters, reduced k-vectors in reduced Brillouin zone, and the eigen-order as the input training dataset, the eigen-frequencies of the photonic modes can be predicted. The group velocity and the eigenfrequency of the slow light mode can be predicted by only input the desired conditions to the trained neural network.

articleTitle: Dense-U-Net assisted improved audio-visual source tracking for speech enhancement
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In this paper, deep learning based improved audio-visual source localization in dynamic environments has been implemented. Acoustic positional information guided visual localization and tracking of target source has demonstrated good performance than localization and tracking using a single modality. However, owing to severe background noise and multipath effects such as reverberation, the acoustic information might suffer from impairments giving rise to inaccuracies which in turn might negatively affect the performance of visual tracking. To mitigate this problem, a specialized deep learning architecture referred to as dense-U-Net is applied to process the noisy acoustic measurements. The de-noised outputs of the dense-U-Net are utilized to provide the acoustic information to guide the visual tracking of target source. It is observed from computer simulations that such a methodology improves the target source localization, under severe noise and reverberation.

articleTitle: A deep learning-based fake news detecting system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Since the birth of the Internet, social media has gradually taken up an increasingly important role in our lives. Whether it's food, clothing, housing, transportation, or keeping up with the latest events, we all rely on the vast amount of news and information provided by social media. Therefore, many unscrupulous business entities that publish all kinds of false information for profit, and the general public is easily misled because of their limited knowledge reserve. In this paper, we embrace the FNC-1 challenge as the foundation for crafting our innovative fake news detection system. In the course of our exploration, we discerned that the FNC-1 dataset was marred by issues pertaining to both class imbalance and data scarcity. To surmount these intricacies, we introduce an original data augmentation approach hinging on the principles of deep learning. Experimental results show that our proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art(SOTA) fake news detection approaches by 6.9% F1 score on the FNC-1 dataset.

articleTitle: Implementing predictive analytics through ANN and Kanban to improve supplier performance
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The supply chain orchestrates the flow from raw materials to customers, involving a network of activities, resources, and organizations. Cooperation across stages maximizes efficiency, cost reduction, and customer satisfaction. Supplier performance is pivotal at the chain's onset, impacting lead times, quality, and partnerships. In Industry 4.0, AI integration, particularly machine learning (ML), enhances supply chains and supplier performance. Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), inspired by the brain's neural network, enable predictive analytics for supplier assessment. Though ANN alone can't improve suppliers' performance, coupling it with Kanban's lean methodologies boosts efficiency. Kanban, a visual workflow tool, enhances efficiency through task representation. By using ANN to predict weaker suppliers based on data, Kanban guides improvements. Using Python, this paper aims to hypothetically increase supplier performance through predictive analytics and Kanban in a makeup/beauty/cleaner supply chain dataset, comprising 100 entries which includes crucial data points such as product details, customer demographics, lead times, order quantities, and more.

articleTitle: An intelligent sign language translation system by integrating facial expressions with hand movements
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Today, communication between humans is essential. Dialog communication is the most convenient and commonly used communication method. However, communication has always been a problem for deaf people. Therefore, there are often many problems due to poor communication. Thus, a communication method with sign language has evolved, but not everyone has the relevant knowledge. Although the communication problem caused by the inability to speak has been solved, there are still many inconveniences. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent sign language translation system that combines expression movements and hand movements to solve the problem of poor communication between deaf people and those who have not learned sign language in society. This paper uses deep learning technology to enhance the interpretation function for hand movements and facial expressions. Compared with other sign language translations, most of which are only for hand movement translation, the situation, diversity, and convenience of sentences are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Intelligent diagnosis and precision analysis of a large gantry type 5-axis CNC machine tool
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The importance of the five-axis simultaneous motion accuracy test (R-TEST) for machine tools cannot be ignored. Through the use of an optical five-axis measurement system, the coordination and accuracy among the axes of the machine tool can be quickly inspected. This test can be used to evaluate the performance of five-axis simultaneous motions and is suitable for various types of equipment testing requirements. The system features wireless operation, automatic compensation mechanisms, compact size, and high convenience of operation. The five-axis simultaneous motion accuracy test ensures the precision and consistency of processed work pieces, helping to avoid machining errors and improve product quality and reliability. Furthermore, with the implementation of the Smart Predictive Diagnostic Performance System (PDPS), which monitors the vibration signals of the spindle, potential issues with the spindle can be predicted in advance. This proactive approach helps reduce machine downtime and maintenance costs while simultaneously improving machine efficiency and productivity.

articleTitle: Smart manufacturing and generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This research combines smart manufacturing, industry 4.0, GAN and style transfer technology to assist the industry to expand more automation technologies.

articleTitle: Interval improved fuzzy partitions fuzzy C-means under Hausdorff distance
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Symbolic interval data analysis (SIDA) has been successfully applied in a wide range of fields, making it a valuable tool for many researchers for the incorporation of uncertainty and imprecision in data, which is often present in real -world scenarios. This paper proposed the interval improved fuzzy partitions fuzzy C-means (IIFPFCM) clustering algorithm that independently combined with Hausdorff distance from the viewpoint of fast convergence and dealing with SIDA with outliers than the traditional interval fuzzy c-means. From the experimental results, IIFPFCM with Hausdorff distance can effectively improve the convergence speed and process the data of outliers.

articleTitle: Fetal nasal bone abnormal detection based on Yolov5
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Fetal nasal bone abnormal is a congenital malformation. Due to the issue of ultrasound image fuzziness leading to potential misdiagnosis and missed diagnosis, we utilized the Yolov5 object detection model with CSPDarknet53 as its backbone for identifying key features in fetal nasal bone ultrasound images. Compared to other experiments Yolov5 demonstrated superior performance with mAP@0.5 and F1-score of 94.8% and 0.95 respectively.

articleTitle: A 78 dB SNDR 500kHz BW continuous-time DSM hybrid 6-Bit SAR ADC with sharing DAC
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In this paper, a low-cost and high-resolution continuous-time delta-sigma modulator (CT-DSM) for Bluetooth communication in an industrial 4.0 environment is presented. The proposed architecture is a second-order CT-DSM. The quantizer is a 6-bit successive approximation register analog-to-digital converter (SAR ADC) with high dynamic range and low power dissipation. Furthermore, a resistive DAC is used to share the DAC between the modulator and the SAR quantizer, reducing the area required. A prototype has been designed and simulated using TSMC's 180nm CMOS process. With a power dissipation of 12.68mW, it achieves 13-bit resolution at 500kHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Smart sensor technologies and its location-aware applications
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Owing to the popularity and miniaturization for the embedded systems, many types of sensors are integrated with the embedded systems as the smart sensors by the electronic manufacturers, and thus the uses can apply the estimation capabilities of smart sensors to perform real-time signal processing, judgment, and control function. This paper introduces a unidirectional localization technology with low-complexity computing in smart sensor nodes. The proposed technology formulates the estimated location of a target as an optimization problem based on the real-time signal estimation, and the problem can be solved in the centralized or decentralized way. The computer simulation results illustrate that in a static localization scenario, the suggested location-aware application exhibits superior estimation accuracy compared to the conventional approach.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of a multi-machine power system connected with a high-capacity DC microgrid containing electric-vehicle loads and hybrid renewable power-generation systems
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: To investigate the impacts and effects of connecting large-scale electric-vehicle (EV) loads to a power system for charging, this paper proposes a DC microgrid including a wind farm, a photovoltaic (PV) power plant, a supercapacitor (SC)-based energy storage system (ESS), and an EV load charging station fed to the simplified Taiwan Power System through a bidirectional DC/AC power converter. The simulation results demonstrate that the integration of the real-time EV power allocation method and the SC-ESS can effectively smooth out active-power fluctuations injected into the studied multi-machine power system.

articleTitle: Sensitivity and economic analyses of various energy-storage systems in a hybrid power-generation system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper presents the economic benefits of a hybrid power-generation system consisting of solar and biomass energy, interconnected with various energy-storage systems (ESSs). The studied ESSs include supercapacitor (SC), flywheel (FESS), lithium-ion battery (Li), lead-acid battery (LA), and vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB), considering their respective prices and characteristics. The economic analysis is carried out using HOMER Pro software package, supplemented by Matlab calculations for the economic indicators of each ESS. In terms of economic analysis, this paper evaluates the overall system's economic benefits using two indicators, i.e., levelized cost of energy and net present cost (NPC). In addition, the benefits of different ESSs in terms of energy storage and surplus power management are assessed using the levelized cost of storage and levelized cost of delivery. Sensitivity analysis is also conducted to examine the impact of interest rates and fuel prices on the overall system under varying conditions of these factors.

articleTitle: Two-axis robot positioning errors model of a semiconductor inspection machine
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper investigated the positioning device of a semiconductor inspection machine, due to its importance of good positioning accuracy. To determine the precision of the machine the API 6D laser measurement instrument was utilized. Subsequently, to understand the effect of angular deviation during movement on the machine's positioning accuracy, the Homogeneous Transformation Matrix (HTM) was used to derive the positioning error model. The measured angular errors obtained from the 6D laser measurement instrument were incorporated into the model. The machine's own CCD facilitated one-dimensional optical scale measurement and two-dimensional optical calibration plate measurement, allowing us to compare the CCD results with the model-calculated outcomes to validate the model's accuracy. Once the correctness of the model was confirmed, an error budget table was established using the model to provide assembly error values for future assembly personnel.

articleTitle: Intelligence in poultry farming: enhancing efficiency and welfare through intelligent manufacturing
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Poultry farming is a crucial industry that plays a significant role in meeting the growing global demand for animal protein. To address the challenges of scaling production, optimizing resource utilization, and ensuring animal welfare, the integration of intelligent manufacturing technologies in poultry farming has emerged as a promising solution. This paper explores the potential applications of intelligent manufacturing, including automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence, in the poultry industry to enhance efficiency, productivity, and animal well-being. By adopting these technologies, poultry farmers can achieve sustainable and profitable operations while promoting ethical and humane practices.

articleTitle: Fitness assistant using sEMG and machine learning
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Exercise-induced fatigue presents challenges to both exercise performance and injury prevention. Through the respected research, the sEMG system possesses the capability to read and detect muscle activity. This finding provides a promising avenue for conducting further investigations and experiments. This review emphasizes the potential of sEMG and machine learning in monitoring and managing muscle stress in sports and exercise settings.

articleTitle: Improved shoe recognition model using vision image transformer (VIT)
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Recognizing shoe types is a computer vision task and has a wide range of practical applications. Traditional approaches for shoe recognition often involve manual cataloging and rely on descriptive image information, which can be time-consuming and imprecise. Deep learning approaches have improved the illustrative catalog system of recognizing shoes. However, advancements in Computer Vision introduced transformer models, which have shown promising results in image recognition tasks. This paper proposed a shoe recognition model using a Vision Image Transformer (ViT) to improve the above approaches. A fully connected layer was added to enable classification tasks. A constructed shoe dataset was trained on Google Colab 3. 10.12 with GPU in Keras using Adam as an optimizer, and 99.2% validation accuracy was achieved. The proposed model performs better than other deep-learning models on the dataset.

articleTitle: The effects of via materials on the scattering matrix and radiation pattern of substrate integrated waveguide antenna
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: We investigate the effects of via material on the S-parameter and radiation pattern in a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) antenna from X to Ku band with a time domain simulation. The via material is changed from PEC into air and alumina. We observe significant changes in resonant frequencies in S-parameters, and naturally in gain and directivity of radiation patterns because of frequency changes. This study shows the possibility of tuning the SIW antenna by changing the dielectric constant of the via arrays.

articleTitle: Real-time instance segmentation of fetal cranial ultrasound images based on improved YOLACT++
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Fetal cranial ultrasound is a non-invasive imaging technique, but its images often have low contrast, noise interference and artifacts, which make analysis and interpretation difficult for physicians. To achieve the localization of key anatomical structures in fetal cranial ultrasound images, in this study, we used YOLACT++ model architecture and Swin Transformer as the backbone to achieve real-time instance segmentation of key anatomical structures in fetal cranial ultrasound images. The results showed that the model with Swin Transformer as the backbone had the best performance, with the mAP@0.5 of 90.51% and 91.44% for Box and Mask, respectively.

articleTitle: Classification of rectal cancer metastases based on deep learning
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Rectal cancer is the cancer between the dentate line and the junction of rectosigmoid colon, which is one of the most common malignant tumors of the gastrointestinal tract and is currently the ninth in the order of death from cancer in China.Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can clearly show the size and extent of rectal cancer and is highly accurate in pre-treatment staging; therefore, the applications of MRI in hospitals are to do more accurate preoperative evaluation.Deep learning (DL) as a new computer-aided diagnosis method has been widely used in medical image processing which can reduce the misdiagnosis by radiologists.This study, an image classification technique based on deep learning to quickly and accurately determines whether the original rectal cancer lesion has metastasized, and the technique can also be used to help imaging students quickly learn clinical and artificial intelligence-related knowledge.

articleTitle: Breast cancer screening with class imbalance datasets of mammogram imaging
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In Taiwan, breast cancer ranks as the fourth leading cause of death among women. Many studies have reported that early detection and treatment are crucial in reducing mortality rates. Mammogram imaging is a key screening tool for the early detection and management of breast cancer. However, the identification and interpretation of breast lesions in mammography is not a trivial task. In addition, the extremely biased ratio of positive and negative case numbers makes it more challenging when it comes to the development of the computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems. Nevertheless, if we resample the negative cases to make the training dataset class distribution even with the positive cases, the total number of cases may not be sufficient for training a deep learning model. To avoid such dilemma, our strategy is to guide the deep learning models to learn the correct features of lesions by the annotations of lesions, including masses and micro-calcifications, from the medical physician. Subsequently, the deep features from the SPPF layer in a detection model of YOLOv5m are extracted for both positive and negative cases. Finally, a classifier of Random Forests is trained based on the extracted feature for mammography screening. For our experiments, the source datasets were from the competition of Screening Mammography Breast Cancer Detection held by Radiological Society of North America (RSNA) in late 2022. And the performance of our proposed reached to 0.624, 0.77, 0.596, and 0.672 for Accuracy, Sensitivity, Precision, and F1-Score, respectively.

articleTitle: Trajectory analysis of quadcopter UAV using software in the loop simulation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The rapid growth of civilian Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) has raised concerns about air navigation and safety. An essential step to address this involves trajectory analysis considering internal and external factors. This research employs Software in the Loop (SITL) simulation using ArduCopter as the Flight Control Software, MAVProxy as the primary Ground Control System (GCS), QGroundControl as the secondary GCS, and MAVLink as the Communication Software to examine the perturbations in Quadcopter UAV trajectories. This study aims to find the most significant parameters in successfully manoeuvring the Figure-8 flight pattern. The parameters analysed consist of alterations in airspeed, wind speed, and wind heading. Results indicate a notable increase in calculated distance error due to changes in airspeed and wind speed, while changes in wind heading exhibit less impact on flight trajectory.

articleTitle: The YOLO object detection and thermal imaging in natural disaster environments advanced intelligent rescue system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Intense earthquakes can cause extensive damage to residential buildings, resulting in casualties and significantly impeding the economic development of affected regions. This system utilizes YOLO object detection and thermal imaging to mutually assist in locating survivors, while also incorporating gas sensors to prevent the diffusion of toxic gases at disaster sites. By increasing the success rate of rescue operations, this system minimizes the risk of injury to rescue personnel. [1]YOLOv7[2] is a state-of-the-art object detection module that has been widely applied across various domains in recent years. Its key feature is the ability to multitask and perform three different tasks simultaneously: object detection, instance segmentation, and keypoint detection. Compared to previous versions, YOLOv7 excels in object detection, providing faster and more accurate object identification. It can effectively detect objects such as pedestrians, buildings, and traffic signals. Moreover, YOLOv7 offers enhanced precision by utilizing color representation to distinguish specific objects using masks. Additionally, it can locate keypoint nodes of the human body in the image, such as the head, elbows, and knees, and connect these key points to create a skeletal structure resembling a stick figure. This capability enables action and poses recognition.

articleTitle: Multi-type tree partition decision for H.266/VVC inter coding based on Random Forest classifiers
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The flexible coding unit block partition structure of the quadtree with nested multi-type tree (MTT) for the newest video coding standard H.266/versatile video coding (VVC) can provide better coding efficiency than that of H.265/high efficiency video coding (HEVC). However, the computational complexity increases markedly. This paper proposes a fast MTT partition algorithm based on machine learning for the inter prediction of the H.266/VVC encoder. The proposed approach utilizes Random Forest classifiers to skip the least necessary MTT split. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm reduces the encoding time with negligible Bjøntegaard delta bitrate (BDBR) under the random access configuration. The proposed method outperforms the previous work.

articleTitle: Throughput analysis for 5G base station
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This article presents throughput analysis for 5G base station. The proposed 5G base station throughput simulation and measurement. The proposed 5G base station throughput simulation is depicted uplink data rate (Mbps), downlink data rate (Mbps), ping value (ms) and jitter value (ms), respectively. Experimental throughput results with 5G mobile device by method tool of ``Speed Test'' and antenna of base station.

articleTitle: Application of human-made pollution sensor module in ventilation facilities
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In recent years, the issue of ventilation has gradually gained attention from the public. However, the currently available low-end Energy Recovery Ventilation (ERV) facilities lack affordable sensor module options, particularly when it comes to CO2 sensors that can be integrated into ventilation facilities. The high cost of CO2 sensors often discourages their inclusion in general households' ventilation facilities or the implementation of ventilation control features. In light of this, this study proposes a sensor module that not only comes at a lower cost but can also be seamlessly integrated with ventilation facilities. This advancement aims to enable autonomous control of ventilation facilities airflow, thereby enhancing energy efficiency and reducing facility costs in the future.

articleTitle: A system for combining Dehazer weather processing with AI traffic light technology enforcement
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This study proposes an integrated roadside system that combines image enhancement for adverse weather conditions with artificial intelligence (AI) technology enforcement at intersections. It aims to address critical issues in traffic management, such as accidents and congestion. The AI optimizes road safety for users, reduces traffic violations, and employs improved methods to control vehicle speed and direction, thereby minimizing accidents and congestion. Furthermore, the system leverages Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based model called All in One Dehazing Network (AOD-Net) used to enhance detection performance under specific conditions, and the YOLOv7 technique accurately identifies vehicles. With these model, the intelligent roadside system can sensitively detect vehicle behavior on the road, better coordinate traffic flow, improve road efficiency, reduce traffic congestion, and decrease the occurrence of traffic accidents. Overall, this intelligent roadside system with AI-powered traffic signal lights is expected to play a vital role in urban traffic management, effectively reducing traffic accidents and congestion, enhancing road efficiency, and providing a safer and more convenient travel experience for the public.

articleTitle: Fraud online payment detection based on machine learning with balancing data technique
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In today's world, online payment has become the most popular transaction method, making payments convenient for people. However, this ease of use comes with the risk of an increasing number of online fraud incidents. Conventional rule-based systems and static fraud detection approaches often struggle to keep up with the ever-evolving tactics of fraudsters. Consequently, there is a growing need for advanced fraud detection methods that can adapt to dynamic fraud patterns, which presents both importance and challenges. This study proposes a fraud online payment detection system based on Logistic Regression and Decision Tree algorithms, enhanced through the use of oversampled data techniques. The experimental evaluation reveals that the Decision Tree, when utilizing the random over-sampling (ROS) technique, outperforms other techniques in terms of accuracy, achieving a remarkable 100% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Spatial-based generative adversarial network for makeup transfer
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In recent years, with the rise of social media platforms, there has been a growing emphasis on personal appearance, leading to an increased demand for makeup products. However, finding the suitable makeup can be time-consuming, constant experimentation with different products can potentially have long-term effects on the skin. Therefore, this study proposes a model architecture for makeup transfer, aiming to accurately transform partial makeup using the exact feature distribution matching (EFDM) method. As results, demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms existing research in terms of both quality and quantitative comparison. Additionally, this model's frechet inception distance (FID) achieves 38.52.

articleTitle: Hardware acceleration of lite CNN-based face direction recognition detector by deep learning processor unit with FPGA
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In the paper, for facial orientation detection, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model based on Xilinx's deep learning processing unit (DPU) is realized effectively determine the facial orientation of pedestrians using FPGA-based hardware acceleration. To reduce the computational complexity by using Depthwise-based convolutions, the developed low-complexity design can provide enough recognition accuracy for the specific application. Compared with the CPU-based software implementation, the proposed design with the DPU-based implementation provides more than two times speed-up performance.

articleTitle: Low-cost vibrotactile sensor using Polyvinylidene Fluoride film for use in virtual haptic data gathering
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Among our five senses, there is limited research on haptics for assistive devices. Vibration being important in haptics is gaining attention and in this research we made use of Polyvinylidene Fluoride (PVDF) film as a tool to measure vibration for use in enhancing touch sensing with tactile feedback. The proposed system does not use any moving parts like motors or pistons but it provides a wide range of tactile feedback sensations to the finger moving across it. This study reveals the use of a haptic display pad with the use of PVDF as both actuator and sensor to let users recognize textures generated through varying vibration frequencies. Results showed that the proposed vibrotactile sensor using PVDF has high accuracy in detecting various frequencies for use in perceivable cutaneous feedback. Further research aims to improve the system for use as a data collection module in virtual texture research.

articleTitle: Concurrent burr detection with collaborative robot
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This research presents a burr detection system capable of analysing workpiece profiles and burr indexing simultaneously during machining process. The proposed system utilizes a Bayesian online changepoint detection algorithm to identify changepoints within the force data sequence and dynamically update burr features of workpiece profiles. This adaptation is crucial to compensate for the inherent rigidity limitations of a collaborative robotic arm. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method and system in real-time burr detection and characterization.

articleTitle: Paraguayan snack recognition system: implementation and comprehensive analysis
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: In this study, we endeavoured to bridge a gap in the global food recognition field by developing a machine learning system designed to identify traditional snacks from Paraguay. Due to the lack of pre-existing data, we created our unique dataset, capturing a diverse range of traditional snacks. Building upon top-tier models from the ImageNet competition, we tailored these architectures to our collection, enhancing the system's capacity to accurately recognize specific snacks. In the pursuit of dynamic interaction and system refinement, we constructed a user-friendly website where individuals can upload images for classification. Crucially, users can correct misclassifications, enabling our model to learn from mistakes and improve incrementally. This active participation of users not only bolsters the accuracy of our model, but also underlines the community's role in preserving Paraguay's culinary heritage digitally. Our work also incorporated YOLO object detection model, empowering the system to locate snacks within any image, adding an invaluable layer of practical functionality. Overall, this project provides substantial insights into expanding the horizons of image recognition systems and illustrates the exciting future of machine learning in preserving global culinary diversity.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: Word card generation for language education using latent diffusion model
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative system for word card generation in language education, utilizing the Latent Diffusion Model (LDM). The system addresses challenges of dealing with copyright compliance, semantic relevance, and inappropriate content in the generated word cards. By integrating CC0 datasets, GPT-4 prompt generation, and Safe Latent Diffusion (SLD) mechanisms for more secure image usage, the system generates contextually relevant word cards under copyright regulations. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the system's success in producing visually appealing word cards, while effectively mitigating the risk of inappropriate content at the same time.

articleTitle: Hybrid modulation optical communication and specific wavelength device-based water mist and smoke discrimination sensing system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This article aims to address the limited sensitivity caused by indoor light source interference and false alarms due to cooking smoke in optoelectronic smoke detection applications. We propose a hybrid modulation optical communication and specific wavelength device-based water mist and smoke discrimination sensing system. The system achieves anti-indoor light source interference at both component and circuit levels, and utilizes a self-developed bandpass optical detector combined with an optical communication hybrid modulation algorithm to further increase the signal-to-noise ratio. Additionally, based on the optical characteristics of smoke, the system uses a multi-wavelength bandpass optical detector array to differentiate between fire smoke and cooking smoke, thereby reducing the system's false alarm rate.

articleTitle: A system dynamics approach of a laptop manufacturing supply chain operation simulation modelling using AnyLogic
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper provides a dynamics approach of a laptop manufacturing supply chain operation simulation modelling mechanism to improve the manufacturing process. This research paper studies and examines the impact of effective supply chain management on business performance and overall profitability. Using a laptop manufacturing case study and simulation modelling using a system dynamics approach, this research utilizes AnyLogic simulation software to optimize supply chain operations. The hybrid method combines agent-based simulations with system dynamics diagrams encompassing causal loops and stock-flow models. The methodology of this research is divided into two phases, firstly by developing the supply chain optimization in Excel that encompasses monthly demand forecasts, production planning, inventory management, and overall profit estimation. Second phase of the research is conducted by developing a system dynamics model in AnyLogic which include the creation of causal loop diagram and stock-flow diagram. Through verification and validation processes, this study refines a throughput-based production model, integrating factors like supply, demand, productivity, and various interactions such as employee dynamics, transportation, stock management, and considering financial modelling. A supporting research verification is done by carrying out experimental designs using sensitivity analysis scenarios to obtain knowledge on the dynamic behaviours and impacts to one another of the supply chain operational elements.

articleTitle: Depth estimation for outdoor monocular images using multiscale transformer
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Transformers have shown a great achievement on dense prediction tasks due to its longrange dependency extraction capability on images. Recently, researchers have applied transformers in depth estimation, and gained superior performance compared to traditional approaches. However, these works mainly exploit transformers at a single scale of the image. Aiming at this, this paper proposes a novel hierarchical transformer-based encoder-decoder model for monocular depth estimation. The proposed architecture relies on stacked transformer encoder to capture depth features at multiple scales which are subsequently combined at the decoder. Moreover, the model discretizes the image depth into bins, in which centers are adaptively learned. In addition, the value for each pixel in the depth map is the linear combination of the bin centers and the bin widths probability distribution. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted with the KITTI outdoor dataset with various metrics, and achieve promising results compared to the state-of-the-art works.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of endometrial cancer based on deep learning
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Endometrial cancer is the most common malignant tumor of the female reproductive system in developed countries, and the second most common malignant tumor in our country. The early detection and treatment can improve the survival rate. Although there are many ways to locate a cancer, the only way to determine whether a cancer is benign or malignant is through a pathological examination. In order to solve the subjectivity of manual diagnosis and improve the speed and accuracy of doctors' diagnosis, this paper uses image segmentation to assist doctors in rapid diagnosis of tumor stages. While improving the diagnostic accuracy, artificial intelligence is used to assist medical students in computer research.

articleTitle: Virtual reality in education: case studies and applications
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) has emerged as a revolutionary technology with immense potential to reshape the landscape of education. This paper delves into the multifaceted benefits of integrating virtual reality into educational settings. It explores the impact of VR on student engagement, knowledge retention, skill development, and inclusivity. Additionally, it examines the challenges and ethical considerations associated with implementing VR in education. By analyzing various case studies and research findings, this paper aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of how virtual reality can enhance the learning experience and foster a more dynamic and immersive educational environment.

articleTitle: Measured radiation power for 5G communication device
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This article presents electromagnetic waves of 5G measurement with channel power, and analyzing the actual radiation of 5G macro base stations. The proposed 5G mobile device provides applied script to continuously uplink to the file transfer protocol (FTP) with the Nemo Handy method at 6 minutes. Experimental condition due to distance difference, measured continue power required by the device to communication with the macro base station, respectively.

articleTitle: Prenatal diagnosis of ventricular septal defect based on YOLOv7
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Prenatal diagnosis of ventricular septal defect(VSD) is very important. Computer-aided analysis can help doctors identify cardiac abnormalities and congenital heart disease. We present a deep learning-based model for the assisted diagnosis of VSD on the fetal cardiac ultrasound images. The model is based on YOLOv7, which extracts knowledge from an annotated database. The model is fed with fetal cardiac ultrasound images that can be visualized in standard views with labels of no-VSD or VSD. The results show that the model achieves a mAP@0.5 of 93.8%, a precision of 86.7%, a recall of 91.5%, and an F1 score of 89.5% on both training and test datasets.

articleTitle: Improving the wavelet transform based adaptive FullSubNet+ with Huber loss
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: By utilizing the adaptive sub-band encoder, the adaptive FullSubNet+ (A-FSN) is a revision of the well-known speech improvement framework FullSubNet+. This allows the A-FSN to capture the local frequency information in a more flexible manner. In addition, it has been demonstrated that AFSN operates more effectively when its real and imaginary spectrogram inputs are replaced by the short-time discrete wavelet transform (DWT) features. The DWT features preserve the phase information of input time-domain signals in addition to the complex-valued spectrogram, and they also serve as an additional form of time-domain features with fixed kernels to learn the A-FSN framework. In this study, it is proposed to train the DWT-based A-FSN (WA-FSN) model using Huber loss, a combination of L1 and L2 loss. It is claimed that Huber loss will lead the trained deep learning model to be more robust when compared to the commonly used L2 loss. This is because the smooth L1 loss avoids the gradient exploding problem that is created by the outlier data. The use of smooth L1 loss gives WA-FSN with superior objective SE scores, as compared to the use of the L2 loss in the preliminary experiments that are done on the Voicebank-DEMAND database and task.

articleTitle: Fast algorithms for multi-windowed dark channel priors with less comparison and time cycle requirement
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The dark channel prior (DCP) is important in image dehazing. Since for a natural image the dark channel value is always near to zero, the DCP is helpful for estimating the transmission and retrieve the original image. However, since the DCP is nonlinear and space variant, it requires a huge amount of comparisons, especially in the multi-window case. In this paper, an advanced DCP implementation algorithm is proposed. We apply the fact that, after taking the minimum of 3 color channels, the DCP is the closing operation with a convex kernel. Thus, we can use an iterative algorithm to compare the rows (columns) with the displacement of 2q. With the proposed algorithm, the number of comparisons is only 2+2ceil(log2L) for each pixel where LxL is the patch size and the required memory is only 3MN where 3xMxN is the size of the color image.

articleTitle: Muti-head self attention are scalable learner for ultrasound image analysis
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Ultrasound images are one of the main task data in medical image analysis, but due to the limited size of the dataset, existing research often finds it difficult to uncover the key characteristics of their data modality. This article starts with a large-scale dataset of 120354 ultrasound images and compares and analyses the current mainstream frameworks for deep learning feature extraction. From the perspective of data frequency and model frequency permeability, it is proposed that using a feature calculation model based on multi head attention mechanism is more suitable for ultrasound image analysis. The conclusion of this article will drive the research of deep learning models in ultrasound image feature calculation.

articleTitle: Embedding a hardware Trojan in the YOLO-v2 neural network model using FPGA implementation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The emergence of deep learning has led to the growing utilization of neural network models as circuit IPs. However, this advancement also brings about the risk of Trojan attacks being introduced into these designs. Previous studies have primarily focused on creating Trojans through convolution layer level modifications. In this paper, we present a novel approach that involves embedding a hardware Trojan within the Softmax layer of YOLO-v2. Our experimental findings demonstrate that the integrity of the traffic object recognition system can be compromised. Furthermore, the attacker gains the ability to arbitrarily replace labels in the images.

articleTitle: Compare neural networks and fuzzy neural networks applied in power forecasting of photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The advancement of renewable energy stands as a crucial global policy. To scrutinize the precision of the photovoltaic modules forecasting model, Internet of Things (IoT) technology is harnessed to procure both environmental data and electrical metrics from photovoltaic power generation. This investigation employs two frameworks: neural networks and fuzzy neural networks. The disparity between actual power and predicted power is utilized to refine and adjust the weights within these networks. Given that initializing the fuzzy membership variables is a more intricate process compared to standard neural networks, additional diligence is typically required.
