This research employs identical datasets and akin structural frameworks for both neural networks and fuzzy neural networks in the modelling process. The findings evince that fuzzy neural networks yield superior accuracy compared to their standard neural counterparts in power forecasting of photovoltaic system.

articleTitle: Voltage stability analysis of multi-microgrid clusters
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper analyses the impact of microgrid clusters on the voltage stability of the IEEE 14-bus multi-machine power system. To simulate the realistic operation of microgrids, a hybrid renewable-energy system consisting primarily of wind and PV power generation is incorporated into the original microgrid architecture. The response of the grid's voltage stability is observed under N-0, N-1, and N-2 contingency. Static voltage stability analysis is performed by observing the system's load margin using P-V curves under different fault scenarios, determining whether the system is at risk of voltage collapse. The power flow distribution and line efficiencies are also examined. Furthermore, a voltage stability index is introduced to quantify the stability of each bus, providing a more intuitive understanding of the voltage-stability differences under different fault conditions. Regarding dynamic voltage-stability analysis, this paper conducts real-time simulations of the response of load buses under various fault scenarios. By comparing static and dynamic analyses, the voltage stability of the studied system can be observed from different perspectives.

articleTitle: Implementation of a 32-bit floating-point multiplier for low-power designs using 90nm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This research paper presents a study of three different multiplier designs: Dadda, Wallace Tree, and Vedic. The study compares the performance of these designs in terms of operation, complexity, delay time, and power consumption. The designs are implemented using 90nm CMOS technology. The simulation results show that the Dadda design is the most efficient design for a 32-bit floating-point multiplier circuit. The Dadda design has the lowest power consumption and is the easiest to implement in hardware. The study also evaluates the designs under various operating conditions to show how they affect power consumption.

articleTitle: Implementation of an AI-based competitive cheerleading coaching assistant system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Competitive cheerleading is a highly complex and intense sport characterized by intricate motions. The complexity and high intensity of the sport often lead to various sports injuries. Therefore, the role of coaches is crucial in the training process of competitive cheerleading. However, due to the insufficient number of coaches, there are inevitably challenges in providing individual attention to all team members during training. To alleviate the workload of coaches and enhance the effectiveness of self-directed training for team members, this study has developed a cheerleading coach assistant system with artificial intelligence technology. This system demonstrates high judgment accuracy and significantly improves the standardization of basic motions for competitive cheerleaders, reducing the possibility of sports injuries.

articleTitle: Design of power amplifier with bandpass filter
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This article presents a 3.5 GHz power amplifier (PA) with 3th-order bandpass loop filter development that uses two stage cascade architecture. The two stages partition power amplifier with Gm-C band-pass filter is promulgated by the tsmc-0.18 um CMOSprocessing with its the P1dB of -22.95 dBm, and conversion gain of 22.57 dB, respectively. Come out chipset arranges 20.72 W with a sourcing voltage of 1.8 V.

articleTitle: Heart left bundle branch block detect system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: According to the WHO statistics, cardiovascular diseases are the leading cause of death worldwide among the top ten causes of death [1]. Among cardiovascular diseases, coronary heart disease has the highest mortality rate, accounting for approximately 16% of global deaths [2]. Left bundle branch block (LBBB) is not only associated with coronary heart disease but also a precursor to dilated cardiomyopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and aortic valve disease [3]. The modern diet, which is high in salt, oil, and cholesterol, has led to an increasing prevalence of cardiovascular diseases, including LBBB [4]. Dr. John F. Schneider's study found that approximately half of LBBB patients die from cardiovascular diseases within ten years [5]. Long-term neglect of treatment leads to a high mortality rate, and even if successfully cured, patients face a high risk of needing a pacemaker for life. This study aims to develop a V1 single-lead design system using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for electrocardiogram (ECG) signal classification. The system utilizes a lightweight and comfortable wearable garment as a measurement device, allowing users to perform self-monitoring of ECG signals and cardiovascular diseases without disrupting their daily activities, thereby reducing the risk of developing cardiovascular diseases.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a bidirectional DC-DC power converter for energy-storage systems of a DC microgrid using a digital controller
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a four-switch synchronous buck-boost converter-based bidirectional DC-DC power converter controlled by using a microcontroller. The designed power converter joins with various components including an auxiliary power-supply circuit, a gate-driving circuit, a voltage-feedback circuit, a current-feedback circuit, etc. The adoption of the digital control scheme enhances the control flexibility and accuracy of the power converter by ensuring precise regulation and dynamic responses. Laboratory experimental results demonstrate that the developed power converter can effectively maintain stable operation under different load-change conditions, thereby verifying its operating stability and effectiveness. Finally, an experimental prototype of the bidirectional DC-DC power converter of rated 400 W is constructed, enabling bidirectional power transmission between its the high-voltage side of 72 V and the low-voltage side of 48 V.

articleTitle: Design and development of a customizable and instructional health education app
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Health education is an important task that needs to be implemented over a long period of time. Nowadays, with the advancement of technology, all kinds of information can be found on the website, but how to avoid receiving inaccurate knowledge among the many pieces of information, it is extremely important to choose a trustworthy platform. This study presents an individualized and informative health education application incorporating caregiver-led video demonstrations. The interactive videos are designed to engage users and employ question prompts, ensuring accurate health education information is disseminated to the public. This, in turn, contributes to advancing and promoting health education.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation using super resolution technique as pre-processing
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Combining high-level and low-level visual tasks is a common technique in the field of computer vision. This work integrates the technique of image super resolution to semantic segmentation for document image binarization. It demonstrates that using image super-resolution as a preprocessing step can effectively enhance the results and performance of semantic segmentation.

articleTitle: Detecting gingivitis through an application by utilizing "YOLOv5", an artificial intelligent software
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Gingivitis is a kind of gum inflammation, it can cause the gum to bleed easily, swollen and dusky red gum and can progress to periodontitis. Visual examination by dentist is the traditional method for diagnosis gingivitis. However, there are limited number of dentists in a resource-limited settings especially in rural areas. We created an artificial intelligent software, using YOLOv5s to help for gingivitis diagnosis. The methods were gathering photo dataset with easily visible gum, then made a train dataset with usable 27 images from a total of 120 images and test dataset to prevent further overfitting via Roboflow, add on multiple attributes, and train the model with the dataset, utilizing YOLOv5s. By the time that was finish, we started creating the application, link the model to the application. The percentage of final precision by normal (no attributes), grayscale, rotated, and rotated with grayscale were 26%, 70%, 93%, and 82%, respectively. In conclusion, the rotated dataset has the most accuracy, but the model and application needs more data and development.

articleTitle: Training and integrating GPT and other language models to build a voicebot system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The paper proposes the integration of multiple models to build a voicebot. We train the GPT model to generate responses from text input from the user, and other models to process the user's audio signal into text and to transform the text output from the GPT model into an audio signal.

articleTitle: Ku-band low noise amplifier with TR switch
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This letter presents Ku-band low noise amplifier (LNA) with TR switch circuit design that uses common source cascade. The integrated third stage LNA with TR switch circuit is fabricated by the tsmc 0.18 um CMOS process with its noise figure of 2.653 to 2.771 dB, stability more than 3.8, respectively. Overall chipset dimension of 0.914 × 0.914 mm2.

articleTitle: FPGA-based implementation of a dynamic hand gesture recognition system
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper presents a low-power dynamic hand gesture recognition system based on an FPGA platform. The system consists of two main components: hand tracking and gesture recognition. A concatenation of image processing methods is proposed for hand tracking to achieve accurate tracking with minimal computational resources. Gesture recognition is performed using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model trained on the NIST dataset. The implementation is done on the PYNQ-Z2 board, utilizing its Python packages to efficiently program image processing algorithms. The power consumption of the system is measured at 2.15 W, which is lower than similar FPGA-based implementations. This research demonstrates the feasibility of achieving low power consumption in hand gesture recognition systems while maintaining high accuracy and performance.

articleTitle: Interworking between SNMP and OM2M supporting the bulk operation
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) is one famous network protocol to collect and organize the information of managed devices. Although newer versions of SNMP have been proposed to improve performance, flexibility, and security, SNMP is still not sufficient to handle the global mass deployment of Internet of Things (IoT). On the other hand, OM2M is the implementation of ETSI SmartM2M and OneM2M that standardized one horizontal common service layer, and then simplify the development of IoT applications. In this paper, we further provide the interworking between SNMP and OM2M. At the same time, we utilize the group management functionality of OM2M to support the bulk operation of SNMP.

articleTitle: A FPGA-based real-valued signals generator for optical wireless communications
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper proposed a FPGA-based real-valued signal generator for optical wireless communications. In the proposed transmitter, DCO-OFDM is used as the optical system which needs the Hermitian symmetry to get the real-valued signals. In addition, we adopt radix-2 algorithm to implement the inverse Fourier transform with 32-bit precision. Experiment results show that the proposed architecture could generate the real-valued signals with low power consumption.

articleTitle: YOLOv7 algorithm and Winograd acceleration circuit for real-time road image recognition and reminder
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Based on the severity and importance of road traffic accidents, this scheme studies how to provide better warnings and help drivers better recognize road conditions and signs, thereby reducing the occurrence of road traffic accidents. The recognition of road signs through YOLOv7 aims to provide drivers with more accurate and real-time road condition information. With the improvement of autonomous driving technology, our real-time traffic signal recognition system can also be used as one of the basic technologies of autonomous driving vehicles, thereby improving the safety and performance of autonomous driving vehicles.

articleTitle: Diffraction efficiency prediction in 2-D metasurface using artificial neural network
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: We aim to train an artificial neural network to predict the diffractive efficiency of 2-D metasurface. Using the geometric parameters, and the polarization of the incident light as the input training dataset, the diffractive efficiencies are showed by the contour maps related to the radii of the pillars. The predicted results show high accuracy in both the parameters that included and not included in the training dataset.

articleTitle: Image-based detection system of guided-mode resonance sensor using 3D printed components
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: We report an image-based detection system of a guided-mode resonance (GMR) sensor using 3D-printed component. A cylindrical lens is used to includes a range of incident angles of the laser launched into the GMR sensor. The image sensor can detect the reflected light corresponding to the resonance angle having the highest intensity. The shift of the highest-intensity position can be used to determine the liquid refractive index on the GMR sensor surface. The measurement result shows that the detection limit can achieve 1.4×10E-4 RIU under the TM polarized incident laser light.

articleTitle: Suppression of subsynchronous resonance in hybrid steam-turbine generator and offshore wind farm using a vanadium redox flow battery-based energy storage system and a static synchronous compensator
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This article discusses the outcomes of mitigating subsynchronous resonance (SSR) in a power system that includes a combination of a hybrid steam-turbine synchronous generator (SG) and an offshore wind farm (OWF). The system is connected to an infinite bus through a series-capacitor compensated line, and the suppression of SSR is achieved by utilizing a static synchronous compensator (STATCOM) in conjunction with an energy storage system (ESS) based on a vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB). The complete system model, which includes the SG, the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG)-based OWF, the STATCOM, and the VRFB-ESS, is established using the d-q axis equivalent-circuit model under balanced loading conditions. A proportional-integral-derivative (PID) damping controller for the STATCOM is designed using a pole-assignment approach based on modal control theory. Small-signal stability and transient simulation analyses are conducted on the studied system. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed STATCOM joined with the VRFB-ESS, along with the designed damping controller, effectively mitigates SSR in the power system being studied.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of a synchronous generator connected to a power grid through a modular multilevel converter-based high-voltage direct-current link
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper studies the stability of a synchronous generator (SG) connected to a power grid through a high-voltage direct current (HVDC) link based on a modular multilevel converter (MMC). The HVDC link consists of different control strategies for the SG-side MMC (SS-MMC) and the grid-side MMC (GS-MMC). Both MMCs operate with different current directions and working modes. Small-signal stability analysis of the studied system using calculated eigenvalues is performed. Dynamic responses of the studied system under disturbance conditions are also carried out to validate the proposed models of the MMCHVDC.

articleTitle: Research on real-time drone dance control system based on high speed mesh communication architecture
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The difficulty of drone swarm is that in addition to enabling each drone to have the ability of "precise positioning" and "obstacle avoidance", it also requires the integration of "reliable high-speed communication system" and "control platform" technology to achieve a perfect drone swarm. Its technology development includes airframe design, assembly testing, communication technology development, precise positioning technology, flight route design and drone control software. However, stable communication transmission is required behind these performances. Therefore, this research focuses on proposing a drone swarm Wi-Fi Mesh System architecture with "a smooth and reliable high-speed communication system" to improve the communication stability of drone swarm performances.

articleTitle: Efficient data management in edge computing
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This study presents the implementation of a Socket-based edge server aimed at optimizing data access performance. The edge server is designed to store previously retrieved data from a cloud database in a buffer, thereby reducing redundant queries to the database. To further evaluate the performance and effectiveness of the edge server, a client program is developed to simulate real-world data access scenarios. Multiple test datasets are utilized to simulate actual data requests, and the time required for the edge server to process each request is measured.

articleTitle: LCD interface to I2C protocal conversion using FPGA
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This paper presents the design of an Intellectual Property (IP) that converts a serial output signal into a parallel output signal for a liquid crystal display (LCD). The IP is intended for utilization with Arduino IDE in the design of the desired display, utilizing the WG12864A Graphic 128x64 LCD for output. The IP is developed through RTL code writing and simulated using Modelsim. Following synthesis using Xilinx Vivado, the final implementation is realized on Xilinx Artix-7 EGO1 and applied in environmental quality monitoring devices.

articleTitle: Refining object grasping in robotic hands using a Mediapipe-based virtual contour method
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This study presents a novel strategy for improving robotic hand grasping via Mediapipe-based virtual contour method. The method allows the adjustment of hand gestures based, calibrates using a grasp matrix, and mitigates common issues in AI-driven grasping. Effective finger posture correction and stable force distribution for object grasping of rectangular objects with different thumb position have been demonstrated with this method through calibrated experiments. The proposed method is well-suited for scenarios where a robotic hand is directly controlled using human hand posture.

articleTitle: Automatic endometrial cancer segmentation based on deep learning
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The incidence of endometrial cancer, a malignant neoplasm originating from endometrial glands, has been on the rise in recent years, and is close to or even exceeding that of cervical cancer.Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can clearly show the size and extent of the endometrial cancer, so as to accurately estimate the stage of the tumor, therefore, the application of magnetic resonance imaging in the hospital more preoperative evaluation.Deep learning (DL) as a new computer-aided diagnosis method has been widely used in medical image processing which can reduce the misdiagnosis by radiologists.In this study, an image segmentation technique based on deep learning was used to locate endometrial cancer lesions quickly and accurately, artificial intelligence can also be used to help medical laboratory students to use computers to learn.

articleTitle: An interactive English learning system with image and speech recognition
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: Many people want to learn spoken English but are hesitant to speak up when they see others, which hinders their ability to improve their speaking skills quickly. This paper introduces a cloud-based speech recognition system that can determine whether the user's spoken English is correct, serving as a basis for deciding whether to proceed to the next stage of instruction. Additionally, this system utilizes PoseNet to recognize if the user leaves their seat and a convolutional neural network to recognize learning emotion. The system pauses the class if the user leaves their seat or appears confused. Then, the user can press a continue button to resume the class. Accordingly, the proposed system prevents the user from falling behind or leaving the seat for other reasons while the system continues the lesson. Experimental results demonstrate that this system significantly enhances English-speaking proficiency.

articleTitle: The intelligent beehive IoT system with the ability to measure bee activity and honey production
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: This research configures a group of temperature and humidity sensors inside the beehive to monitor the environmental changes within the hive. Furthermore, a servomotor is installed at the ventilation entrance to control the opening of the ventilation gate, thereby preventing the bees from being exposed to unsuitable growth conditions for an extended period. Additionally, the honey production is observed through the feedback from the Force Sensitive Resistor (FSR) to measure changes in honey yield. Moreover, Laser Sensor and Light Intensity Sensor are used to detect the frequency of bee entry and exit from the hive. The sensor data from each beehive is aggregated using LoRa transmission technology and sent to the Receiver. The Receiver then utilizes NB-IoT to transmit the data to a cloud server, allowing beekeepers to monitor real-time honey production and identify any issues where bees are unable to produce honey in a timely manner.

articleTitle: Fatigue driving detection based on YOLOv7 algorithm and MEC acceleration circuit design
publicationTitle: IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (ICETA 2023)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to develop an efficient and accurate fatigue driving detection system to improve road traffic safety. Different from the traditional method based on infrared light source, we use neural network image recognition technology, which can provide more accurate and flexible fatigue driving detection results. The average accuracy mAP of the final training model is 91%, the precision is 85.5%, and the recall is 90.2%. In addition, in order to explore the acceleration calculation method of the fatigue driving detection system, we adopted the Memory-efficient Convolution (MEC) technology. MEC can reduce the memory consumption in the convolution operation while increasing the calculation speed. Our research develops an efficient and accurate drowsy driving detection system.
